meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十项「好设计」原则逐条审查你的设计,每条打 0~3 分并附证据,判定「新建/优化/重做」,再产出一段可交给 /make-plan 的提示词;它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说「审查这个设计」「设计评审」等关键词,或要求提出能引出计划的批判时触发。日常 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改、尚无设计稿的构思不适用。

say.text: 审查一下这个设计,对照 Rams 十原则打分
say.note: 会逐条打分、给裁决并输出 /make-plan 提示词

say.text: 评审这个页面的 UI,并给出下一步计划
say.note: 先锁定审查范围,再并行走证据收集

say.text: 这个设计该新建、优化还是重做?
say.note: 按总分和是否出现 0 分项判定

howto.what_en: Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with evidence, gives a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and produces a paste-ready /make-plan prompt. It writes no code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design," "design review," or ask for a critique meant to lead to a plan. Routine UI code reviews, pure copy edits, and pre-design ideation are out of scope.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: Scores all ten principles and returns a verdict

say_en.text: Review this UI and tell me what to plan next.
say_en.note: Locks scope first, then gathers evidence in parallel

say_en.text: Should this design be new, refined, or redesigned?
say_en.note: Verdict follows total score and any 0-scored principle
